body.triggerFrequency: Per investment advice or portfolio management service

summary.text: When giving investment advice or managing a portfolio, the firm obtains the information it needs about the client's knowledge and experience of the relevant investment area, financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance. It recommends only the services and financial instruments that are suitable for the client, in particular in light of that risk tolerance and ability to bear losses.

translations.text: When giving investment advice or managing a portfolio, the firm obtains the information it needs about the client's knowledge and experience of the relevant investment area, financial situation including the ability to bear losses, and investment objectives including risk tolerance. It recommends only the services and financial instruments that are suitable for the client, in particular in light of that risk tolerance and ability to bear losses.

Vid investeringsrådgivning eller portföljförvaltning ska företaget inhämta de uppgifter det behöver om kundens kunskap och erfarenhet på det aktuella investeringsområdet, ekonomiska situation inklusive förmåga att bära förluster och investeringsmål inklusive risktolerans. Det ska bara rekommendera tjänster och finansiella instrument som är lämpliga för kunden, särskilt med hänsyn till just den risktoleransen och förmågan att bära förluster.

title.text: Document the reasons when advising a switch of underlying investments

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee
body.productScope: Underlying assets in KF and pension insurance

summary.text: When advice involves switching underlying investments, the distributor documents why the benefits of the switch outweigh its costs, and gives the customer a written explanation of how the advice meets their preferences and objectives before the switch is made.

translations.text: When advice involves switching underlying investments, the distributor documents why the benefits of the switch outweigh its costs, and gives the customer a written explanation of how the advice meets their preferences and objectives before the switch is made.

När rådgivningen innebär byte av underliggande placeringar ska distributören dokumentera varför fördelarna med bytet överväger kostnaderna, och ge kunden en skriftlig förklaring av hur rådet motsvarar kundens önskemål och mål innan bytet genomförs.

title.text: Assess appropriateness before non-advised trades in complex instruments

body.triggerFrequency: Per order in a complex instrument
body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Before providing a non-advised service in a complex financial instrument, the institution asks about the client's knowledge and experience and assesses whether the service or product is appropriate. If it is not appropriate, or information is missing, the client is warned.

translations.text: Before providing a non-advised service in a complex financial instrument, the institution asks about the client's knowledge and experience and assesses whether the service or product is appropriate. If it is not appropriate, or information is missing, the client is warned.

Innan en tjänst utan rådgivning tillhandahålls i ett komplicerat finansiellt instrument ska institutet begära uppgifter om kundens kunskap och erfarenhet och bedöma om tjänsten eller produkten passar kunden. Om den inte passar, eller om uppgifter saknas, ska kunden varnas.

title.text: Make appropriateness warnings prominent and do not encourage clients to ignore them
Report ISK standard income to Skatteverket every year

summary.text: The institution calculates the standard income for each investment savings account and reports it to Skatteverket in the annual control statement.

translations.text: The institution calculates the standard income for each investment savings account and reports it to Skatteverket in the annual control statement.
Institutet ska beräkna schablonintäkten för varje investeringssparkonto och lämna den till Skatteverket i den årliga kontrolluppgiften.

title.text: Define a target market and distribution strategy for each product

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: For every financial instrument manufactured or distributed, the institution defines a target market, checks that the distribution strategy fits it, and reviews both regularly.

translations.text: For every financial instrument manufactured or distributed, the institution defines a target market, checks that the distribution strategy fits it, and reviews both regularly.
För varje finansiellt instrument som produceras eller distribueras ska institutet fastställa en målgrupp, säkerställa att distributionsstrategin passar den och regelbundet se över båda.

translations.text: Research from third parties may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in the rules.
Investeringsanalys från tredje part får tas emot endast om den betalas med institutets egna medel, från ett analyskonto, eller gemensamt med orderutförande enligt de villkor som anges i reglerna.

title.text: Pay for third-party research only under the permitted models

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Research from third parties may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in the rules. The institution sets criteria for an annual assessment of the quality, usability and value of the research it uses. If the research does not contribute to better investment decisions, the institution takes corrective action.

translations.text: Research from third parties may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in the rules. The institution sets criteria for an annual assessment of the quality, usability and value of the research it uses. If the research does not contribute to better investment decisions, the institution takes corrective action.

Investeringsanalys från tredje part får tas emot endast om den betalas med institutets egna medel, från ett analyskonto, eller gemensamt med orderutförande enligt de villkor som anges i reglerna. Institutet ska fastställa kriterier för en årlig bedömning av kvaliteten, användbarheten och värdet av den analys som används. Om analysen inte bidrar till bättre investeringsbeslut ska institutet vidta åtgärder.

Varningar efter en passandebedömning ska vara tydliga, framträdande och inte vilseledande. Företaget får inte tona ned en varning eller uppmuntra kunden att gå vidare trots den, och ska dokumentera varningar och om kunden ändå genomförde affären.

title.text: Assess appropriateness before non-advised trades in complex instruments
Honour the policyholder's right to transfer pension insurance savings

summary.text: A policyholder may transfer the value of a pension insurance to another insurer. Fees for the transfer are limited by law.

translations.text: A policyholder may transfer the value of a pension insurance to another insurer. Fees for the transfer are limited by law.
En försäkringstagare har rätt att flytta värdet av en pensionsförsäkring till en annan försäkringsgivare. Avgifterna för flytten är begränsade i lag.

title.text: Apply safeguards to solely automated decisions with significant effects

body.retention: As long as needed for the purpose
body.sanctionExposure: IMY fine up to 4 percent of turnover

summary.text: A person has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that significantly affects them, unless an exception applies and safeguards such as human intervention are in place.

translations.text: A person has the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that significantly affects them, unless an exception applies and safeguards such as human intervention are in place.

En person har rätt att inte bli föremål för ett beslut som enbart grundas på automatiserad behandling och som i betydande grad påverkar personen, om inte ett undantag gäller och skyddsåtgärder som mänskligt ingripande finns.

title.text: Assess appropriateness before non-advised trades in complex instruments
Disclose all costs and charges before and after the service

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Clients receive aggregated information on all costs and charges of the service and the instrument in good time before the service, and at least annually afterwards, with the effect of costs on return.

translations.text: Clients receive aggregated information on all costs and charges of the service and the instrument in good time before the service, and at least annually afterwards, with the effect of costs on return.
Kunder ska i god tid få sammanställd information om alla kostnader och avgifter för tjänsten och instrumentet, och därefter minst årligen, med kostnadernas effekt på avkastningen.

title.text: Pass every notification for registration of a right over securities to the CSD at once

summary.text: An account-holding institution passes every notification it receives for registration of a right over securities on to the central securities depository (CSD) at once. When it is in doubt about facts or law that matter to the registration, or someone claims the registration would infringe their rights, it reports the notification for provisional registration, and the CSD decides how final registration can be made.

translations.text: An account-holding institution passes every notification it receives for registration of a right over securities on to the central securities depository (CSD) at once. When it is in doubt about facts or law that matter to the registration, or someone claims the registration would infringe their rights, it reports the notification for provisional registration, and the CSD decides how final registration can be made.

Ett kontoförande institut ska genast vidarebefordra varje anmälan om registrering av en rättighet över värdepapper som det tar emot till värdepapperscentralen (CSD). Är institutet osäkert om faktiska eller rättsliga förhållanden som har betydelse för registreringen, eller hävdar någon att registreringen skulle kränka dennes rättigheter, ska det anmäla för preliminär registrering, och värdepapperscentralen avgör hur den slutliga registreringen kan ske.

title.text: Hold only approved investment assets on an ISK

summary.text: Only approved investment assets may be held on an investment savings account. Assets that stop qualifying must be moved out within the period the act allows, and the customer is told.

translations.text: Only approved investment assets may be held on an investment savings account. Assets that stop qualifying must be moved out within the period the act allows, and the customer is told.

På ett investeringssparkonto får endast godkända investeringstillgångar förvaras. Tillgångar som upphör att vara godkända ska flyttas från kontot inom den tid lagen anger, och kunden ska informeras om det.

segments.text: På ett investeringssparkonto får endast godkända investeringstillgångar förvaras.
Tillgångar som upphör att vara godkända ska flyttas från kontot inom den tid lagen anger.
Tillgångar som upphör att vara godkända ska flyttas från kontot inom den tid lagen anger, och kunden ska informeras om det.

title.text: Establish demands and needs and assess suitability for insurance-based investment products

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Before an insurance-based investment product is concluded, the distributor specifies the customer's demands and needs and, when advising, assesses whether the product and its underlying assets are suitable.

translations.text: Before an insurance-based investment product is concluded, the distributor specifies the customer's demands and needs and, when advising, assesses whether the product and its underlying assets are suitable.

Innan ett avtal om en försäkringsbaserad investeringsprodukt ingås ska distributören klargöra kundens krav och behov och, vid rådgivning, bedöma om produkten och dess underliggande tillgångar är lämpliga.

title.text: Document the reasons when advising a switch of underlying investments
Provide a key information document before the customer is bound

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Retail customers receive a key information document for the packaged or insurance-based investment product in good time before they are bound by a contract.

translations.text: Retail customers receive a key information document for the packaged or insurance-based investment product in good time before they are bound by a contract.
Icke-professionella kunder ska få ett faktablad för den paketerade eller försäkringsbaserade investeringsprodukten i god tid innan de blir bundna av ett avtal.

title.text: Assess suitability when giving investment advice

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: When giving investment advice, the institution obtains information on the client's knowledge, experience, financial situation and objectives, including sustainability preferences, and recommends only what is suitable. The reasons are documented and given to the client.

translations.text: When giving investment advice, the institution obtains information on the client's knowledge, experience, financial situation and objectives, including sustainability preferences, and recommends only what is suitable. The reasons are documented and given to the client.

Vid investeringsrådgivning ska institutet inhämta uppgifter om kundens kunskap, erfarenhet, ekonomiska situation och mål, inklusive hållbarhetspreferenser, och bara rekommendera det som är lämpligt. Skälen ska dokumenteras och lämnas till kunden.

title.text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 conformance

instrument.implementsNote: The Nordic national standards bodies adopt this edition under references of their own. Which adoption a bank certifies against is the bank's to record.

summary.text: A bank that has chosen to follow this edition meets every requirement it sets and can show that it does. The text of the standard is licensed: it is read at the publisher's catalogue, not here.

translations.text: A bank that has chosen to follow this edition meets every requirement it sets and can show that it does. The text of the standard is licensed: it is read at the publisher's catalogue, not here.
En bank som har valt att följa den här utgåvan uppfyller varje krav den ställer och kan visa att den gör det. Standardens text är licensierad: den läses i utgivarens katalog, inte här.

title.text: Keep clients' instruments and funds separate and reconciled

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Clients' financial instruments and funds are kept separate from the institution's own, records allow each client's holdings to be identified at any time, and holdings are reconciled regularly.

translations.text: Clients' financial instruments and funds are kept separate from the institution's own, records allow each client's holdings to be identified at any time, and holdings are reconciled regularly.
Kunders finansiella instrument och medel ska hållas åtskilda från institutets egna, registren ska när som helst visa varje kunds innehav, och innehaven ska stämmas av regelbundet.

items.title: ESMA finalises technical standards on ICT third-party risk reporting

case.soWhatText: Confirm the ICT register covers every third-party arrangement in scope.

title.text: Give the retail client a suitability statement before an advised trade

body.triggerFrequency: Per advised transaction, before it is carried out
body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: Before a transaction is carried out after investment advice, the institution gives a retail client a suitability statement. The statement sets out the advice given and how it meets the client's preferences, objectives and other characteristics. It is provided in a durable medium.

translations.text: Before a transaction is carried out after investment advice, the institution gives a retail client a suitability statement. The statement sets out the advice given and how it meets the client's preferences, objectives and other characteristics. It is provided in a durable medium.

Innan en transaktion genomförs efter investeringsrådgivning ska institutet ge en icke-professionell kund en lämplighetsförklaring. Förklaringen anger vilka råd som lämnats och hur de motsvarar kundens preferenser, mål och andra egenskaper. Den lämnas på ett varaktigt medium.

title.text: Keep a register of information on ICT third-party arrangements

body.sanctionExposure: FI remark, warning or sanction fee

summary.text: The financial entity maintains an up-to-date register of all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers and identifies those supporting critical or important functions.

translations.text: The financial entity maintains an up-to-date register of all contractual arrangements with ICT third-party service providers and identifies those supporting critical or important functions.
Den finansiella entiteten ska föra ett aktuellt register över alla avtal med tredjepartsleverantörer av IKT-tjänster och ange vilka som stöder kritiska eller viktiga funktioner.

items.title: ESMA finalises technical standards on ICT third-party risk reporting

case.soWhatText: Confirm the ICT register covers every third-party arrangement in scope.

items.subjectTitle: Pay for third-party research only under the permitted models
items.description: The summary still says research may be paid from the institution's own resources only. The new wording we were sent names a research payment account as well.

segments.text: Investment research from a third party may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in these regulations.
The institution shall assess annually the quality and value of the research it receives.

items.label: Proposal
items.usageNote: A draft rule or final report proposed for adoption. Dates are proposed, not decided.

items.label: Adopted
items.usageNote: Decided by the legislator or authority, application still ahead. The prototype's 'Adopted rule', 'EU legislation' and 'EU regulation' land here until they apply.

items.label: Supervision
items.usageNote: Surveys, thematic reviews, supervisory statements. No new rule.

items.label: Enforcement
items.usageNote: A decision against a named firm. Structured facts live in enforcement_decision.

items.label: Recurring date
items.usageNote: A date the law repeats every year, such as a rate fixing or a reporting deadline.

items.label: Consultation
items.usageNote: A draft open for comments with a closing date. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: In force
items.usageNote: The rule applies from the date given. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: Guidance
items.usageNote: Guidelines, Q&As, circulars and position papers from an authority. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: Court ruling
items.usageNote: A judgment that settles how a rule reads. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: Conduct
items.usageNote: How the firm must act towards the client.

items.label: Disclosure
items.usageNote: What the client must be told, and when.

items.label: Record-keeping
items.usageNote: What must be documented and kept.

items.label: Reporting
items.usageNote: What must be sent to an authority.

items.label: Governance
items.usageNote: Organisation, policies, registers and oversight.

items.label: Technical
items.usageNote: A rule a system enforces, such as eligibility of an asset.

items.label: Follow up
items.usageNote: A marker for records someone must come back to. Relabel it; it is the list's default.

items.label: Act now
items.usageNote: Something must change within weeks.

items.label: Within 3 months
items.usageNote: Work must start this quarter.

items.label: 6+ months
items.usageNote: Plan it, no rush.

items.label: Monitor
items.usageNote: Nothing to do yet, watch for the next step.

items.label: No action
items.usageNote: Noted, nothing changes for us.
